g.text: Cycles as statechart transitions: revisit, bound, yield, scope self-loop
/ full exit: snapshot history, exit activities;
The yield parks already due, so the recovery
scheduler resumes it automatically through the
same self-signed timerFired path as a due timer:
one ledger round-trip per iteration, Enter-phase
Counters live in token context, so concurrent branches
and separate invocations never share a budget, and the
count survives suspension, checkpointing, and history.
